title: Protect workflow is rerun last, and only after the other rerun requests
answers: protect check fails immediately after a retry
Protect used up an attempt while other CI jobs were still rerunning
why is protect rerun after the other workflows
body:
Symptom: The Protect check fails straight away on a retry while the other failed workflows are still being rerun, which uses up one of the commit's limited retry attempts.
Root cause: .github/workflows/retry.sh: the while loop over `rows` sends non-protect reruns to `rerun ... &` and records the protect run in `protect_id`; `protect_id` is rerun only after `wait`.
Fix pattern: Keep Protect out of the parallel batch. Submit it after `wait` returns so it is requested only once the other rerun requests have been sent.
Constraints: Per the PR review, Protect should be submitted only when every preceding rerun request succeeds, and a failure should still give a nonzero exit. In the diff as shown, backgrounded `rerun` calls do not report their exit status back, so that check must be added explicitly. `wait` covers the rerun requests, not the workflows finishing. Only one protect run is tracked.
applies: Applies to rerun ordering in .github/workflows/retry.sh; does not cover which runs are selected as rerun candidates.
says: The protection check fails immediately on retry while other failed tests are still restarting.
Retrying failed checks wastes an attempt because the merge gate restarts too early.
Ensure automated retries trigger the protection check only after restarting all other workflows.
Automatic retry should not run the protection verification before other jobs are re-queued.
search: In .github/workflows/retry.sh, the protect workflow must be excluded from the parallel rerun batch and submitted only after preceding rerun requests are sent. Applies to rerun ordering using protect_id and wait, without covering which candidate runs are selected by the script. Only tracks a single protect run, wait only ensures requests were submitted rather than completed, and background exit codes are not automatically caught.
